title: Seed saving dry chain
summary: Keeps saved seeds dry, labeled, testable, and useful across seasons.
content: Seed saving dry chain is a practical offline routine for seed saving. Save seed only from healthy plants with known source and location. Dry seeds in shade with airflow before sealing. Label crop, variety if known, date, place, parent plant notes, and collector. Keep a small test sample separate from the main reserve. Run germination tests before planting large beds.
